_purpose: Running record of live SharpOds runs: predictions, closes, results, and the lessons folded back into the engine. CLV against the close — not P&L — is the KPI (Squares & Sharps; Sharper).

slates.mode: degraded — no sharp-book anchor reachable (network policy); consensus/article sources, sharpness 0.55-0.60
slates.engine_verdict: PASS: no side cleared the EV bar. Best candidate: Tigers ML, fair 1.617, limit order at >= 1.633 — never filled (line closed 1.56-1.59, moving toward Detroit).

metrics.note: n=5 is far below Buchdahl's significance floor; numbers logged, not believed.

lessons_applied: Passing was correct: the two most-likely sides (DET 62%, PHI 59%) both lost on blown 7-0 and 6-0 leads; every listed price was -EV vs fair.

Fair lines tracked no-vig closes well (4/5 within 0.8pt) but the PHI miss (2.4pt) shows consensus-anchor tail risk -> engine change: EV bar scales 2.5x when no market-maker-grade book anchors the fair line (Engine.degraded_ev_multiplier).
Hand-computed price targets were the day's real output -> engine change: target_decimal on every candidate, BetCard.price_targets(), rendered as limit orders.
Snapshot JSON now carries its own book-sharpness registry so degraded runs are reproducible from the CLI.
